alt: Six peer boxes list structural, behavioral, ownership, decision, measurement and provenance models with the questions each answers. A separate representation-form axis lists graph, registry, state machine, contract, table and quantitative relation. Model purpose and representation form are distinct; shared identity and traceability connect the models. Gray fills distinguish the source semantic roles; labels and line conventions retain their meanings.
